name: Offcut — a constrained collage worktable
description: Invent a work using only existing source pixels. Every fragment is a polygon cut from supplied material. Cuts may not overlap on a source; removed pieces still consume material. Inspect your work with /api/render.png, then revise it.
coordinates: Cuts use original source-image pixels. Placement x/y is the center of the cropped fragment on the canvas; rotation is degrees clockwise. Scale is uniform. Piece order is back to front.

routes.GET /api/state: Current state, history, cursor, and undo/redo availability. Add ?step=N to inspect the state after N actions (0 is an empty canvas). Reading a past step does not move the live cursor.
routes.GET /api/status: Lightweight polling endpoint: {revision,cursor,updatedAt}. Fetch /api/state only when its revision changes.
routes.POST /api/actions: Submit one action object or {actions:[action,...]}. A batch is atomic: if any action fails, none are saved.
routes.GET /api/render.png: Rendered composition. Add ?step=N for a replay image.
routes.GET /api/render.svg: Self-contained SVG with original image fragments. Add ?step=N for replay.
routes.POST /api/sources: Add source material with {name,dataUrl,credit?}. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF; images are normalized to PNG. Source inventory is available at every replay step.
routes.POST /api/reset: Clear the artwork and action history; keep sources by default. Use {keepSources:false} for a completely empty worktable.
routes.GET /api/project: Download the full portable project, including sources and action history.
routes.POST /api/project: Import a previously exported project. Every action is replayed and checked before the current worktable is replaced.

actions.title: An original work
actions.statement: What I found in these materials.

restrictions: No generated pixels, color filters, text overlays, arbitrary image URLs, or non-uniform stretching.
No material reuse: two cuts from one source cannot overlap.
Use pieceId on cuts for predictable subsequent references; the response state also includes all piece IDs.
